description: Client only. Show the local player a message from you, prefixed [AI], in their chat or on the action bar. Nothing is sent to the server or other players, so use it rather than send_chat to talk to the player. It works while the player has paused you (get_status reports aiPaused); formatting codes are removed and text is cut at 512 characters.

actionBar.description: Show it briefly above the hotbar instead of in chat.

name: show_message
title: Show a message to the player
